resources.string: Estimate a meal from a photo and a short description, using your own AI key.
A profile is one AI service and model with its key. A photo goes to number 1 first. If it can\'t answer (no quota, busy, an error), number 2 tries, and so on. Switch a profile off to skip it.
No AI profiles yet. Add one to start estimating photo meals.
Backup: used when the ones above can\'t answer
No key saved: skipped. Tap Edit to add one.
Key rejected on the last try: skipped. Fix the key, then Test.
Its API key is removed from this phone. You can undo this right after.
Its API key is removed from this phone, and %1$s moves up one place. You can undo this right after.
e.g. I usually cook with olive oil; my dinner plates are 27 cm
Sent with every photo. Don\'t include personal details.
Estimates count toward today immediately, marked AI·review until you check them.
Only the photo is deleted. The log entry and its nutrition stay.
This address isn\'t encrypted (http). Only use it on your own network or VPN.
How to get an API key
Copy the key, come back here, and tap Paste.
Come back here, tap Paste, then Choose from list and pick a model that can read images.
Gemini keys are free to start. A free key has daily limits, and Google may use what you send to improve its products. Turning on billing for the key\'s Google Cloud project makes it a paid key.
Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account.
Tap Create API key. Pick a project, or let AI Studio create one.
If Save and test says Google didn\'t accept this type of key, use option 2.
Open the Gemini API page, check the project name at the top (create one if needed), and tap Enable.
Open Credentials, then tap Create credentials › API key.
Edit the new key. Under API restrictions, choose Restrict key, tick Gemini API, and save. Google rejects keys that have no restriction.
Free or paid: a key is free unless billing is linked to its project. If you link billing, add a budget alert there too.
Claude has no free tier. You pay per estimate from prepaid credit: about a cent per photo with Sonnet, less with Haiku. A Claude.ai Pro or Max plan doesn\'t include API use.
Sign in to the Claude Console, or create an account.
Add credit under Settings › Billing. Requests fail until the account has credit.
Optional: set a monthly spend limit under Settings › Limits.
Open API keys and tap Create key. Name it Forkcast.
Copy the key (it starts with sk-ant-). It\'s shown only once. Come back here and tap Paste.
Get a key for an OpenAI-compatible service
This works with OpenAI, with OpenRouter (one key for many AI models), or with an AI server you run yourself. Follow the one you use.
Sign in to the OpenAI API platform. It\'s separate from ChatGPT, and a ChatGPT plan doesn\'t include API use.
Add credit under Settings › Billing (prepaid, $5 minimum). Auto-recharge is on by default; switch it off if you don\'t want it.
Open API keys and tap Create new secret key. Copy it; it\'s shown only once.
Sign in to OpenRouter, open Keys, and create a key. Copy it.
Add credit for paid models. Models whose names end in :free need no credit but have low daily limits.
Install Ollama on a computer on your network, then download a model that can read images (a vision model).
Let your phone reach it: set OLLAMA_HOST to 0.0.0.0:11434 on that computer and restart Ollama.
Server URL: http://<the computer\'s IP address>:11434. Leave the API key empty.
Works only on your home network or VPN. Small local models judge portions less accurately.
The saved key stays until you save a new one.
%1$s rejected the API key. Check it in Settings → AI.
No API key saved for this profile.

Google didn\'t accept this type of key for this request. If the key is new, wait a few minutes and test again. If it keeps failing, create the key in the Google Cloud console instead (How to get an API key, option 2).
The Gemini API isn\'t turned on for this key\'s Google Cloud project yet. If you just created the key, wait a few minutes and test again.
The key isn\'t valid. Check that the whole key was pasted, with nothing extra.
This key has API restrictions that block the Gemini API. Check the key\'s restrictions in Google Cloud Console.
This key isn\'t allowed to use this model or API.
Check the key in this profile, then test again.
%1$s is busy or at its limit. Try again in a minute.
%1$s\'s quota is used up. It resets later.
%1$s doesn\'t have the model %2$s. Pick another in the profile.
%1$s sent an answer Forkcast couldn\'t read. Try again.
No connection. Connect to the internet, then test again.
No connection. The estimate will run when you\'re back online.
%1$s took too long to answer. Try again.
%1$s had a problem (error %2$d). Try again later.
Forkcast can estimate a meal from a photo or a short description. For that it uses an AI service that you connect with your own account.
What it takes: a free Google account (or a paid Anthropic account) and about 5 minutes.
Everything else works without it: scan a barcode, search for a food, or add your own.
You turned off AI estimates. Turn them on to estimate a meal from a photo or a description.
